description: Create a new OpenClaw cron job. Wraps `cron.add`. Field names match the gateway wire format (verified by the Control panel SPA + live calls), NOT the README placeholders sometimes seen in the MCP source: schedule uses `expr`/`tz` (cron) or `everyMs` (every) or `at` (exact); payload.agentTurn uses `message` and `timeoutSeconds`. Examples: `{ schedule: { kind: "cron", expr: "0 13 * * 5", tz: "Europe/Paris" }, payload: { kind: "agentTurn", message: "...", timeoutSeconds: 180 } }`.

instance.description: Optional OpenClaw instance to route this call to (e.g. 'default', 'work'). Falls back to the active default instance, or the OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_URL/TOKEN env vars when set. List configured instances with openclaw_setup_list.

deleteAfterRun.description: Self-delete after one fire — useful for one-shot reminders.

accountId.description: Channel account id when several are configured.

mode.description: 'announce' broadcasts to the configured channel; 'direct' sends as DM; 'none' keeps the result internal.

to.description: Channel-specific recipient, e.g. a Telegram chat id (-1001234567890) or an email address.

id.description: Optional explicit id; gateway generates one if omitted

name.description: Job name shown in the Control panel

message.description: The text the agent receives at fire time. Used with kind='agentTurn'.

model.description: Override the default model for this job, e.g. 'claude-sonnet-4-6'.

text.description: Event text (used with kind='systemEvent' and a few internal agentTurn flavors).

timeoutSeconds.description: Hard cap for the agent run. Default agentic monitors should use ≥120s (cold-start ~10-15s).

everyMs.description: Interval in milliseconds. Required when kind='every'.

expr.description: 5-field cron expression, e.g. '0 9 * * 5'. Required when kind='cron'.

tz.description: IANA timezone, e.g. 'Europe/Paris'. Used with kind='cron'.

name: openclaw_cron_add
